summary.zh: 先让观众猜错一次，再揭晓为什么：钩子短语 → 证据片段 → 选项倒数揭晓 → 满屏释义 → 情景复证 → 评论区互动。适合有常见误解、能出一道选择题的产品（功能被误会、菜名名不副实、知识点反常识）
summary.en: Let viewers guess wrong once, then reveal why: phrase hook, evidence clip, options with countdown and reveal, full-screen meaning card, scene replay, comment prompt. Fits products with a common misconception that can be framed as a multiple-choice question
